problem: OnlineRL should exploit prior data without constraining improvement to a possibly poor offline dataset or allowing unstable value extrapolation.
contribution: A simpleSAC-based recipe combining balanced prior/online sampling, layer-normalized critics and sample-efficient updates with ensembles.
algorithm: Sample half a training batch from prior data and half from online replay. LayerNorm limits pathological critic extrapolation; high update-to-data ratios and critic ensembles improve sample efficiency. Some choices, including entropy and clipped-doubleQ, are explicitly environment-dependent.
observations: State and pixel observations across continuous-control benchmarks.
actions: Continuous task-specific controls; rewards and transition records must be available for both offline and online samples.
embodiment_and_data: D4RLAntMaze, Adroit and locomotion plus visual-control domains; prior datasets vary in quality. These are predominantly simulation benchmarks, not evidence forROSMASTER hardware.
experiments: Compare online improvement curves and ablate sampling, normalization, regularization, ensemble and environment-sensitive choices; report means and standard deviations across10seeds.
baselines: SACfD and domain-specific strongest prior approaches such asIQL+fine-tuning andOff2On, rather than one weak universal baseline.

quantitative_result.reason: Benchmark learning curves were examined but exact return coordinates were not digitized;10seed aggregation is explicit.

limitations: HighUTD and ensembles consume compute; extrapolation control is not a physical-safety bound. Performance depends on domain-specific entropy/critic choices and available reward labels.
hardware_adaptation: Compare only afterNX memory/update-throughput measurement. Use explicit demonstration versus interaction provenance and keep optimizer work off the actuator control loop.
algorithm_detail: Symmetric sampling preserves prior-data influence as the online buffer grows. CriticLayerNorm addresses unbounded extrapolation without a policy constraint; ensemble/highUTD choices are separate from the50/50sampling contribution.
integration_contract: Every replay transition binds observation, dispatchedaction, rewardmodel, termination/truncation and sourceepisode. Record actual optimizer updates per environment step and dataset sampling proportions.
license_evidence: Primary paper and public codecandidate verified; no code license/source audit completed, so no copied implementation is claimed.
required_experiments: Balancedversusbuffer-prefill ablation; normalization andUTD ablations; equal-resource target-only comparison; optimizer/reload tests and heldoutclosed-loop outcome evaluation.
difference_from_explorer: RLPD already reuses mixed-quality offline data during online learning; source mixing alone is not an original evidence-grounded skill-memory contribution.
